title: Addon Installation & Recipe Guide
description: Learn how to install the Aetheria Addon behavior and resource packs into Minecraft, enable experimental features, and craft custom recipes.
author: Aetheria Team

sections.title: 1. Installing Behavior & Resource Packs
sections.content:
To use the Aetheria Addon in your Minecraft world:

1. Download the `.mcaddon` or `.mcpack` files.
2. Open the file to automatically import it into Minecraft.
3. Navigate to **World Settings > Resource Packs** and activate **Aetheria Textures**.
4. Navigate to **World Settings > Behavior Packs** and activate **Aetheria Behaviors**.

sections.title: 2. Required Experimental Toggles
sections.content:
Ensure the following experimental settings are turned **ON** in your world settings before loading:

- **Holiday Creator Features**
- **Upcoming Creator Features**
- **Custom Biomes**

sections.title: 3. Unlocking Recipes in the Enchanted Forge
sections.content: Custom weapons and blocks require the **Enchanted Forge** or standard 3x3 crafting tables. Inspect individual item pages in this wiki for detailed grid layouts and ingredient requirements.
